# sonrai_account_disabled_services_authoritative (Resource)

Authoritative set of disabled services for one account.

**This resource owns every disabled service in the account.** Any service disabled in the account but absent from `control_keys` is re-enabled on the next apply, including changes made from the console, by another configuration, or by automation. Use `sonrai_account_disabled_service` instead to manage individual services without claiming the rest.

Import the account before first use to see what it already has.

Changes are staged and take effect once submitted and deployed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Declares the complete set of disabled services for one account. Services
# disabled in the account but not listed here are re-enabled.
#
# Import the account first to see what it already has:
#   terraform import sonrai_account_disabled_services_authoritative.prod \
#     'aws/r-abcd@123456789012'
resource "sonrai_account_disabled_services_authoritative" "prod" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"

  control_keys = [
    "cloud9",
    "sagemaker",
  ]
}

output "prod_scope" {
  value = sonrai_account_disabled_services_authoritative.prod.scope
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_keys` (Set of String) Firewall control keys to disable, such as `cloud9` or `sagemaker`. Services disabled in this account but absent from this set are re-enabled.
- `resource_id` (String) Cloud-native id of the account: an AWS account id, a GCP project id, or an Azure subscription id. Organizational units, folders, management groups and roots are not accepted.
- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the form `root_scope@resource_id`.
- `scope` (String) Canonical scope path the account resolved to, recomputed on every read.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is root_scope@resource_id.
terraform import sonrai_account_disabled_services_authoritative.prod 'aws/r-abcd@123456789012'
```
